records.subject: spec-guard-codex-cli-hook
evidence: host:codex exec --json -m gpt-5.5 -s read-only ran from an isolated synthetic Git project with the installed plugin enabled
result:the CLI exited 0; the sole matching session machine record had matching thread id and project path and exactly one developer context with a valid MAP_ONLY stage
limit:this proves the Codex CLI hook on a synthetic project; native Codex Desktop hook behavior and Local ticket replies were not tested by this run

records.subject: spec-guard-codex-default-smoke
records.reason: The repository smoke exited 2 before grading the hook and reported an unknown configured model. A separate explicit model probe received an account-model HTTP 400, but the exact cause of the default run was not established. A manual session with an accepted model verified the hook separately; the default-model run is not counted as a product failure or pass.

records.subject: spec-guard-codex-desktop-hook
evidence: host:a newly created native Codex Desktop task received a human user prompt in an isolated synthetic Git project with a capability map and no module specs
result:the matching Desktop session machine record contains a developer context with the valid MAP_ONLY stage; the task reply reported the same stage
limit:the preceding task-to-task delegation message did not trigger UserPromptSubmit and is not counted; this test does not access the real Local ticket ledger
